lines.speaker: clerk_novi
lines.text: Allocated goods only. If it is not on the quarterly schedule it does not exist, and I would ask you not to describe it to me, because then I have heard of it.

lines.speaker: clerk_novi
lines.text: Two shelves. Both rations. The schedule came down eleven percent this quarter and no explanation is owed to a commissary clerk, and I have checked whether one is owed, twice.

lines.speaker: clerk_novi
lines.text: Half of this came in from outside the schedule and I have stopped filing the discrepancy. There is a clause somewhere in the charter that says people may hold things. I have read it nine times and it says what I think it says.

lines.speaker: clerk_novi
lines.text: You are the auditor who asked the question. No, I am not going to report it. I would quite like to know the answer, and I have wanted to know it for rather longer than you have.
